text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I went to the library on an errand
and spotted Tosen Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, this is rough... My head's still throbbing~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: My pal helped me study earlier, and now my head is pounding~...
choice_data_list: You were studying!? Good for you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What's with that reaction...?! Ugh, so annoying...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My pal cleared their schedule just to teach me,
so the least I can do is take it seriously for once!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm sayin' I'm tired~.
I don't have time to deal with you right now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! It's starting to throb again~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her headache persisted for quite a while after that,
remaining a constant source of trouble...
